response.text: Stone is best because it is the strongest.
Arch is best because it will last longest.
Stone is best for a permanent crossing.
Choose timber: its cost is within 80 and it remains safe in the spring flood; it trades permanence for affordability.
Choose trestle: it supports carts and meets the two-day repair constraint; the trade-off is more routine maintenance.
Choose rope: it is pedestrian safe and has the lower cost; stone offers durability that was not required.
